full_judgment: 3. The petitioner was not aware of the enlistment of the property as abandoned property and as such, could not approach the Court of Settlement in time for exclusion of the said property from the list of abandoned property. She, however, field an application before the Court of Settlement on 7.12.93 with a prayer for exclusion the disputed house from the list of abandoned property but the Court of Settlement rejected the prayer on the ground that the application was barred by limitation.
